usage: Each id names a damaging mutation whose rejection must be executed by every producer check.py via explicit exceptions active under -O, listed in the contract 'controls', and validated by identity and exact Boolean after coherent hash rebinding. Semantics are one line; the triage gives the derivation context.

universal.semantics: Orthant two-anchor count must fail against the seven incident anchors R-S for R={0,e_z}; uniform model adds the two single-factor selected groups.
48 links and 36 distinct endpoints of R reconstructed; four drawn links are insufficient.
s=alpha*t_E/hbar versus u=s/8 and exponent 3 versus 24; nonunit-scale fixture must expose the eightfold error.
Vector centering residue d^2 versus scalar subtraction -2md-d^2; uncentered vacuum residue m^2 retained as a rejecting control.
If omega(W) is first order in tau (+-tau/144 candidate), m^2 and any cross term are charged explicitly; a zero-mean assumption is rejected.
State term evaluated at tau and tau/100 must scale by 100 for a claimed O(tau) bound and by 10 for a square-root bound; a sqrt bound relabelled linear is rejected.

Packet fields tau, selected triple, s, kernel, reference and model id must equal the contract; results at tau=1e-14, s=1/2, Haar-in-selected or finite-graph presented under the cap label are rejected.
Editing a required control Boolean or removing a contract-declared instruction snapshot with every hash rebound must still be rejected.
Original-cap and Poisson-floor insufficiencies are reported at unchanged tau, s, triple; retuning to pass is rejected.
Admission Booleans depend only on Fraction arithmetic with directed enclosures; Arb/mpmath/numpy values are labelled previews and are not read by any admission check.
Deterministic correlated node errors add linearly (T*epsilon); division by sqrt(N) or by 64 is rejected.

Applying 'only supports meeting R' to the numerator alone gives a volume-dependent wrong value on a fixture; the exact product split psi=psi_out+delta is required.
Dropping |xi><Omega_R| or its adjoint or Tr_out|delta><delta| from the reduced density changes a resolvable fixture value.
A creation support meeting both R and its complement is counted in epsilon<=2||c||_a+||c||_a^2 and shown to enter omega(W) only at second order.
sum over supports meeting R bounded by |R|*||c||_a=2||c||_a; a per-site maximum is not summed over the whole volume.
R=1/64, J<=28|tau|, G(R)<148/7, G'(R)<352 re-evaluated as exact rationals; remainder J(G(t)-16) charged, never zero.

Convergence of the onsite-cutoff ground vector (not only eigenvalues) to the untruncated finite-volume ground is proved before rho_R bounds are passed; a claim citing AM2 section 6 alone is rejected.
Finite-volume bound uniform in N passed to the AQ subsequential density by local trace-norm convergence; no rate, uniqueness or whole-sequence claim inserted.
g(3)=e^{-3s} and g(x)=e^{-sx} at sampled x>=0 verified with directed enclosures; free reference C_0(s)=g(3)/4 recomputed.
A fixture spectral atom at x=-1 shows the window returns g(-1) not e^{s}; nonnegativity of the actual centered generator (AQ1) is cited as the essential premise.
||ghat||_1=2 and int|theta||ghat|=4s/pi proved with directed pi bounds from |ghat|=(4s^3/pi)(s^2+theta^2)^-2; ghat in L^1 stated.

Seven-star ||B_N||<=49|tau|/8 (G units) versus the extensive total norm; relative-unitary domain argument retained.

shift.semantics: Exact E[W^3]=0, E[W^2 W_f]=0 for every omitted f including f=W, E[W^2]=1/4, E[W^4]=1/8 from SU(2) character multiplicities; Monte Carlo is preview only.

The claimed first-order coefficient of C(s)-e^{-3s}/4 must be shown zero by parity (state, Duhamel and energy pieces separately); a nonzero first-order claim requires exhibiting the odd-multiplicity link.
No omitted face maps a four-link j=1/2 vector back into the energy-3 multiplet; first-order splitting is zero.
omega(W)=-(2/3)v_W E[W^2]+O(tau^2)=+-|tau|/144 with sign from the frozen lambda*sum(1-W_p) convention; only f=W contributes.
An omitted face other than W contributes zero to omega(W) at first order; substituting another face is rejected.
tau->-tau flips the sign of omega(W) and leaves C(s) unchanged to first order; both signs reported.
The enclosure of omega(W) must exclude 0 strictly at the cap with the second-order remainder (AM2 remainder ~1.9e4 tau^2, straddling and density terms) paid; margin reported.
Remainder terms listed separately: AM2 J(G(t)-16), straddling-support pairing with outside excitations, |delta|^2 density terms; none set to zero.
A certified omega(W) shift is labelled a static equal-time effect; it is not relabelled a dynamical correction or a mass shift.
